name: George Dill
bio: George began making linoleum block prints as an effort to engage in creativity and unplug from social media consumption. His work however revels in some of those viral moments - especially when high tension devolves into absurdity. George's line drawing style is informed by his previous work as an engineer and early childhood aspirations to be a newspaper comic strip artist. These pieces show George's growth in the techniques of linoleum block and screen printing, which he started learning at the Chicago Printmakers Collaborative in 2025.
